summary: Iteration-15 verified all iteration-15 features: per-variant product galleries, restored long product HTML with single h1, tight product-page spacing, cart drawer with left gap, scroll-to-top on navigation, skeleton loaders (no handle flash), SEO-only 1px h1 on collections with merged breadcrumbs, technical SEO on every storefront page, WebP image variants, slim list payloads, and bolder homepage category tiles. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass. All 8 frontend flows pass at 390px mobile and 1920px desktop.

performance.evidence: Homepage total content-length sum ≈ 635 KB across 75 responses (down from old 4.8MB baseline and even below ~1.5MB dev target). Product images served as image/webp when ?w= is in ALLOWED_WIDTHS {160,300,480,600,900,1200}. /api/products, /api/articles, /api/collections list responses contain no description/body_html/translations fields.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py serve_file (line 1509) only produces WebP for w in ALLOWED_WIDTHS={160,300,480,600,900,1200}. Requesting ?w=800 (not in set) silently returns the original PNG (verified: 435 KB PNG vs 20 KB WebP at w=600). If the frontend ever emits a non-allowed width, users get the fat original. Consider snapping to the nearest allowed width or expanding the set.
HEAD /api/files/... returns 405. Cloudflare/browser preflight checks that use HEAD will fail. Add HEAD support or accept GET-only.

Iteration-14 finding (React Router v6 pattern '/pages/html-sitemap-:kind' silently falling through to StaticPage) was not part of iteration-15 scope but remains open — no retest done here per agent-to-agent note (bulk-translate job running, no backend edits).
